scenes.title: Sela Thorn at pier four
scenes.summary: The party meets Sela Thorn, a tide-reader who mends nets, and hires her to row them out for two silver, but never at night. She says Saltmere flooded the night the bell first rang forty years ago, and the water came up warm.

scenes.title: Saltmere Mine
scenes.place: Saltmere Mine, cliff path above Gullwick
scenes.summary: The mine is warm and smells of candle wax. Thirty paces in the tunnel is flooded with warm black water, and hymn-book pages float on it. One page is marked in pencil "M. Brand", and Teo recognises his sister Mira's handwriting. Dana and Priya guess that harbor-master Maren is in the cult. Oren takes 2 damage from the bad air.

scenes.title: Midnight at the drowned chapel
scenes.place: Shore below the old chapel ruins, Gullwick bay
scenes.summary: At dusk the party goes to the shore despite Sela's warning. Fishermen warn them about the Kelp Mother and leave. At midnight the bell rings twelve times under the water, the humming is much louder, and pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor. The party flees. The GM notes privately that the choir clock is at three of six.

scenes.title: Stew and a plan at the Tarred Gull
scenes.place: The Tarred Gull tavern, Gullwick docks
scenes.summary: The party plans to have Sela row them out at first light tomorrow and dive to the chapel at low tide. Innkeeper Bram feeds them and says he has known Maren for thirty years and that she lost a brother to the bay. The party takes a long rest.
